name: Braintree Area Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Open Tue and Fri at Causeway House. Referral required via local agencies including Anglia Care Trust.

name: Braintree District Council Allotments
short_description: 10 council-managed allotment sites across Braintree District
description: Braintree District Council owns and runs 10 allotment sites. Plots average 126 square metres at £75.60 per year. Waiting lists available. Includes taps and communal spaces.

name: Down to Earth Community Garden
short_description: Mental health and wellbeing community garden
description: Therapeutic garden at Braintree Recreational Ground supporting adults with complex mental health challenges. Weekly sessions with Wilderness Foundation UK. Fully funded by UK Shared Prosperity Fund.
